newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF seen posting 96 profit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF seen posting 96 profit - paper.

text.p: French privatisation candidate Thomson-CSF is expected to post a net attributable profit of between 700 and 800 million francs in 1996, after a net loss of 712 million francs in 1995, French daily Le Figaro said.
Le Figaro cited a source close to the company. The results are due to be released at 0800 GMT on Wednesday.
Some analysts expect the defence electronics firm to post a 1996 net attributable profit up to 1.2 billion francs, the newspaper said.

The government's terms and conditions for the Thomson-CSF sale by private placement are expected to be sent to the independent Privatisation Commission by the end of this week or early next week, it said.
The Commission's decision will not be published in the Official Journal, the report added.
